rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is not convenient.

example.english: It’s inconvenient to go to the bank at this time.
example.traditional: 呢個時間去銀行唔方便。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 si4 gaan3 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 m4 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use this when the inconvenience mainly means causing trouble, effort, or hassle.

example.english: Having you come all the way over is really inconvenient.
example.traditional: 要你特登過嚟一轉，真係麻煩。
example.jyutping: jiu3 nei5 dak6 dang1 gwo3 lei4 jat1 zyun2 zan1 hai6 maa4 faan4

rows.note: Use this when an object, tool, or arrangement is awkward to reach or handle.

example.english: The socket is behind the cabinet, so it’s inconvenient to use.
example.traditional: 個插蘇位喺櫃後面，用起上嚟唔就手。
example.jyutping: go3 caap3 sou1 wai2 hai2 gwai6 hau6 min6 jung6 hei2 soeng5 lei4 m4 zau6 sau2

rows.note: Use this when the inconvenience is that a place or journey is out of the way.

example.english: I won’t go to that supermarket; it’s too inconvenient.
example.traditional: 我唔去嗰間超市，太唔順路喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 heoi3 go2 gaan1 ciu1 si5 taai3 m4 seon6 lou6 laa3
